Rewritten in all five locales against the fact registry. The two probe zeros (--sources 68->0, --claims 0 failures) are NOT the justification: the POST refuter showed on 2026-09-12 that both zeros held while the metadata still published the property alternative without its BERSYARAT condition, while the duration was stated flat where the registry says `up to`, while the 10-year cap was quoted without the Pasal 113 first-grant condition, and while a BPN validation method nobody published was prescribed. Those six findings were cured in a second round. The claim that each could then go red was FALSE and the refuter proved it: restoring `verification with BPN records` in all five locales left --claims at zero, because REQUIRED is satisfied file-wide by strings living elsewhere (finding 11). The guard was rebuilt in a third round: 30 removed formulations pinned per locale, four pinned corpus-wide, and six ANCHORED checks per locale that bind a claim to the FIELD or the TABLE ROW that must carry it (Duration cell, Renewal cell carrying Pasal 113, and the own-name plus completed-unit conditions in description, excerpt, seoDescription and answerSnippet). Measured, not asserted: nine mutations applied to a sandbox copy of the five files -- the BPN step restored, the Duration cell flattened to `5 years`, own-name dropped from description, Pasal 113 dropped from Renewal, `14-30 working days` restored, a day range put back in a stage heading, the IDR 5,000,000 fine restored, `What counts as proof` restored, `60 months` restored -- and all nine turn the probe red, with the sandbox green before and after. Two edits came out of the anchoring and are FORM, not substance: the Italian description and answerSnippet said `intestato a te` and `a tuo nome` where the other fields say `a proprio nome`, now uniform; the Russian answerSnippet says `готовой квартирой` where the other fields say `завершённый` -- both native, so the anchor accepts either form and still demands the condition in that field. Then a THIRD refuter round defeated the rebuilt guard in seven measured ways (currency read only before the amount; `Rp. 2.000.000.000` and `IDR 2.0 billion` unmatched; an allowlisted line whose meaning is reversed by the line above it; the table's Financial requirement row unanchored; pins covering base-commit wording but not the wording removed in the intermediate rounds; the 180-day figure unpinned), so the honest statement is this: the probe MEASURES (0/0/0, reproducible) and its regression protection is PARTIAL AND EVADABLE. Nine mutations red, seven evasions open, both measured. Per the imperator's ruling of 2026-09-12 the guard redesign is split out as PR-1b with a written spec (research/secondhome/probe-guard-spec-v2.md) rather than cured in a fourth round, because a fix-of-a-fix stops at depth 1 and an under-specified surface gets a spec. What protects this family at merge time is the fresh independent gate on content-vs-registry, the i18n claim ratchet, and the literal FORBIDDEN patterns proved red by mutation. The disposition rests on the cured claims and on that, never on the zeros.
